content: Hey beautiful, how was your day? I couldn't stop thinking about you all afternoon.
Aw, you're so sweet. My day was okay, just a little lonely. How about you?
I wish I was there to keep you company. You deserve someone who makes you feel cherished every day.
That's really kind of you to say. It means a lot, honestly.
Speaking of us, guess what? I found the cutest little house just outside the city. It made me think about our future together.
Really? That sounds amazing! Tell me more.
It's perfect for us, bright kitchen, cozy living room, even a garden. I can already picture us making breakfast together. I spoke to the landlord. It's available, but only if we act fast.
Wow, that sounds like a dream. What's the next step?
The landlord said there's a lot of interest and only one slot left. We need to send a $2,000 deposit today to lock it in. I know it's sudden, but I don't want us to lose this chance.
That's a lot of money. Are you sure this is legit? I'm a little nervous.
I completely understand, darling. I talked to the landlord via video, he's very professional. Plus, it's a secure transaction. I would never put us at risk. I can't wait to build a life with you.
Okay, I trust you. How do I send the money?
The landlord only takes Zelle or bank wire. I can give you his Zelle handle if that's easiest for you. Do you have Zelle set up?
Yes, I have Zelle. Can you send me the details?
Perfect! The Zelle handle is 'securehomesllc@gmail.com'. Make sure to send it as soon as you can, love. Can you confirm your full name and address so I can put it on the application?
Okay, my name is Karen Miller and my address is 1452 Main Street, Apt 3B. I'll send the money now.
You are truly amazing, Karen. Thank you for trusting me. I promise, this is the start of something wonderful for us.
I really hope so. I want this to work out for both of us.
It absolutely will. Once everything is set, I'll call you and we can plan our first night there. You're my everything.
I'm sending the payment now. Let me know when you get a confirmation.
Got it, love! I'll let you know as soon as the landlord confirms. Thank you for believing in us.
